title: QA Pilot Work Proposal
description: A governed repair proposal produced by QA-Pilot from a diagnostic finding. The proposal is advisory-only: it contains no owner approval, no execution permission, and no mutation authority. It is consumed by the Librarian (via human review) to create a work packet draft. QA-Pilot does not call Librarian work packet tools directly. The proposal preserves the full provenance chain from diagnostic report through test definition.

source_diagnostic_id.description: Reference to the originating diagnostic report (qa-diagnostic-report.schema.json report_id)

source_test_id.description: The test definition that failed (qa-diagnostic-report.schema.json test_id)

failure_summary.description: Summarized failure context from the diagnostic report

severity.description: Severity inherited from the diagnostic report

affected_domain.description: Domain inherited from the diagnostic report

suggested_objective.description: Suggested work objective for the Librarian work packet. Advisory — the Owner may revise.

must_not_modify.description: Paths, records, or systems the repair must not touch

required_validation.description: Tests that must pass after repair

constraints.description: Execution boundaries inherited from the diagnostic report

rerun_tests.description: Concrete test commands or test IDs that must be rerun

regression_test_proposed.description: Whether a new regression test is proposed (handled by QA-PILOT-REGRESSION-LEARNING-LOOP-1, not this sprint)

verification_requirements.description: Verification requirements for the work packet. Must be concrete — no empty or missing values.

diagnostic_to_proposal.description: Mapping from diagnostic report field to proposal field

proposal_to_work_packet.description: Suggested mapping from proposal field to Librarian work packet field

status_mapping.description: Observational status mapping — QA-Pilot does not control Librarian states

compliance_mappings.description: Compliance and mapping metadata for the Librarian consumption specification

limitations.description: Explicit limitations — the proposal confers no authority

provenance.description: Provenance chain preserving the full diagnostic to proposal trace
